data.title: 阿斯特蕾亚 · 居家毛衣沙发上的西瓜满足
data.description: 客厅暖风习习，阿斯特蕾亚穿着蓬松的宽松米色毛衣，坐在沙发前地毯上大口啃着红瓤西瓜，腮帮鼓鼓满是幸福。
data.action: 盘腿坐在柔软地毯上，双手抱着鲜甜西瓜片，鼓着塞满食物的双颊傻笑
data.lighting: 阳台薄纱滤过的柔和散射光，室内气氛暖融融
data.camera: 近景平视，聚焦灵动的可爱吃相与毛绒针织纹理
data.promptProse: Astraea sits cross-legged on a fluffy living room rug beside a plush sofa, happily indulging in a large crescent of crimson watermelon. Wearing an oversized beige chunky knit sweater that slips comfortably off one shoulder, her cheeks puff out with sweet fruit as she beams an innocent, carefree smile. Soft filtered daylight through lace balcony curtains wraps the domestic scene in golden warmth.
data.animaCaption: Sitting cozily by the sofa, Astraea munches on a crisp slice of watermelon with puffed cheeks and pure contentment.
